description: Read and manage HCP Terraform (Terraform Cloud) organizations, projects, workspaces, runs, plans, applies, state versions, variables, variable sets and teams on app.terraform.io in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in HCP Terraform session, including CSRF-protected writes.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the authenticated user profile including username, email, and 2FA status.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List all organizations the current user belongs to. Returns organization name, plan, and resource count.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific organization by name.

tools.name: list_organization_members
tools.description: List members of an organization with their status and email.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects in an organization. Projects group workspaces together.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get detailed information about a project by its ID.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project in an organization.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update a project name or description.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project. The project must have no workspaces.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces in an organization. Supports filtering by name search and pagination.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Get detailed information about a workspace by its ID.

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create a new workspace in an organization. Optionally specify project, execution mode, Terraform version, and other settings.

tools.name: update_workspace
tools.description: Update workspace settings. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_workspace
tools.description: Permanently delete a workspace. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: lock_workspace
tools.description: Lock a workspace to prevent new runs. Provide an optional reason.

tools.name: unlock_workspace
tools.description: Unlock a workspace to allow new runs.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List runs for a workspace. Returns run status, message, and change detection.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific run including status, plan details, and available actions.

tools.name: create_run
tools.description: Queue a new plan/apply run for a workspace. Optionally set as destroy, plan-only, or refresh-only.

tools.name: apply_run
tools.description: Apply a run that is waiting for confirmation. The run must be in "planned" or "policy_checked" status.

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel a run that is currently planning or awaiting confirmation.

tools.name: discard_run
tools.description: Discard a run that is waiting for confirmation. The plan will not be applied.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Get details about a plan including resource changes and status. Use the plan ID from a run's relationships.

tools.name: get_plan_json_output
tools.description: Get the JSON-formatted output of a plan. Returns the planned resource changes in machine-readable format. The plan must be finished.

tools.name: get_apply
tools.description: Get details about an apply including resource changes and status.

tools.name: list_state_versions
tools.description: List state versions for a workspace. Returns version history with serial numbers and status.

tools.name: get_current_state_version
tools.description: Get the current (latest) state version for a workspace.

tools.name: list_workspace_variables
tools.description: List all variables for a workspace including Terraform and environment variables.

tools.name: create_variable
tools.description: Create a new variable in a workspace. Set category to "terraform" for Terraform variables or "env" for environment variables.

tools.name: update_variable
tools.description: Update a workspace variable. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_variable
tools.description: Delete a workspace variable.

tools.name: list_variable_sets
tools.description: List variable sets in an organization. Variable sets allow sharing variables across workspaces.

tools.name: get_variable_set
tools.description: Get detailed information about a variable set.

tools.name: create_variable_set
tools.description: Create a new variable set in an organization. Set global to true to apply to all workspaces.

tools.name: delete_variable_set
tools.description: Delete a variable set.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List teams in an organization.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Get detailed information about a team including member count and visibility.

tools.name: list_team_access
tools.description: List team access permissions for a workspace. Shows which teams have access and their permission levels.
